English.Char_Desc_2000:
SWEEPR Cleaner is a modern, easy-to-use PC cleaner and speed booster for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
Designed for everyday users who are tired of old PC cleaners filled with popup ads, bundled junkware, and slow background programs, SWEEPR Cleaner frees up gigabytes of storage and speeds up your computer in under 60 seconds.
Key Features: - Fast & Lightweight (5.4 MB): Opens instantly and finishes full PC scans in under 60 seconds. - No Background Slowdowns: Runs only when you open it, with zero popup ads or unwanted extra software. - 7-Day Undo Safety Net: Keeps cleaned files in a safe recovery folder for 7 days so you can restore anything with one click. - Deep PC & App Cleanup: Safely clears old Windows temporary files, browser clutter (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave), and leftover files from chat apps (Teams, Zoom, Slack, Telegram, Discord). - Speed & Startup Booster: Frees up memory instantly, includes a 1-click Gaming Mode, stops unnecessary startup programs, and tidies up your right-click menu. - Complete App Uninstaller & Updater: Drag and drop any app to remove it along with all its hidden leftover files, fix broken shortcuts, and update your apps in one click. - Duplicate Finder & Large File Mover: Finds identical duplicate photos and files, shows a clear map of what is filling up your drive, and moves huge files to another drive in one click. - Privacy & File Shredder: Clears tracking cookies without logging you out of your favourite websites, checks if your email was leaked in a data breach, and permanently shreds private files so they can never be recovered.
